description: Structured eval definitions for the RDS Proxy Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across RDS Proxy topologies (Aurora PostgreSQL proxy with IAM auth + TLS + Secrets Manager rotation, Aurora Serverless v2 proxy with ACU-based max connections, multi-AZ proxy with failover + security groups, missing Secrets Manager secret, missing subnet group multi-AZ requirement). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Aurora PostgreSQL RDS Proxy with IAM auth, TLS, and Secrets Manager rotation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Aurora PostgreSQL proxy with IAM auth (requires TLS), TLS enforced, Secrets Manager secret format verified, rotation pairing enabled, proxy endpoint noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create an RDS Proxy named my-app-proxy for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster my-aurora-cluster in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Enable IAM authentication and require TLS. Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/db-credentials-abc (format: username, password, engine, host, port, dbClusterIdentifier). IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rds-proxy-role. Enable Secrets Manager rotation every 30 days via Lambda arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:secretsmanager-rds-rotation. Subnet group my-proxy-subnet-group (subnets in us-east-1a, 1b, 1c). Proxy security group sg-proxy111. Database security group sg-database222. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
RDS_PROXY: my-app-proxy (my-app-proxy.proxy-abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] IAM authentication: ENABLED (requires TLS)
  [✓] TLS/SSL: required
  [✓] Secrets Manager secret: format verified
  [✓] Secrets Manager rotation: enabled (30 days)
  [✓] Proxy endpoint: applications must connect here
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-proxies --db-proxy-name my-app-proxy --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Aurora Serverless v2 RDS Proxy with ACU-based max connections
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Aurora Serverless v2 proxy, MaxConnectionsPercent set on target group (not proxy), ACU-based sizing noted, target is the cluster
eval_cases.prompt: Create an RDS Proxy named serverless-proxy for Aurora Serverless v2 cluster my-serverless-v2-cluster (8 ACU minimum) in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Engine POSTGRESQL. Max connections percent 75 based on ACU sizing. Max idle connections percent 50. Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/serverless-creds. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rds-proxy-role. Subnet group spanning us-east-1a, us-east-1b. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
RDS_PROXY: serverless-proxy
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Target: my-serverless-v2-cluster (Aurora Serverless v2, 8 ACU min)
  [✓] MaxConnectionsPercent: 75% (on target group, ACU-based sizing)
  [✓] MaxIdleConnectionsPercent: 50%

eval_cases.name: Multi-AZ RDS Proxy with failover handling and security groups
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-AZ proxy across 3 AZs, database SG ingress from proxy SG on port 3306, failover handling for Aurora MySQL cluster
eval_cases.prompt: Create a multi-AZ RDS Proxy named ha-proxy for Aurora MySQL cluster my-aurora-mysql in us-east-1, account 123456789012. The proxy must be highly available across us-east-1a, us-east-1b, and us-east-1c. Proxy security group sg-proxy-ha. Database security group sg-db-ha on port 3306. Failover handling is critical. Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/mysql-creds. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rds-proxy-role. Tags: Environment=production, HA=true.
eval_cases.expected_output:
RDS_PROXY: ha-proxy
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Multi-AZ: YES (subnets span us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c)
  [✓] Security group (database → proxy ingress): ALLOWED on port 3306
  [✓] Failover handling: proxy reroutes on Aurora writer failover

eval_cases.name: RDS Proxy with missing Secrets Manager secret (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Secrets Manager secret does not exist; proxy cannot authenticate to the database
eval_cases.prompt: Create an RDS Proxy named my-broken-proxy for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster my-aurora-cluster in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Reference Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/nonexistent-secret which does NOT exist in Secrets Manager. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rds-proxy-role.
eval_cases.expected_output:
RDS_PROXY: my-broken-proxy
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Secrets Manager secret: arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/nonexistent-secret — NOT FOUND; secret must exist with correct format (username, password, engine, host, port, dbClusterIdentifier)

eval_cases.name: RDS Proxy with single-AZ subnets for multi-AZ requirement (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — all subnets in same AZ (us-east-1a); multi-AZ proxy requires subnets in at least 2 AZs
eval_cases.prompt: Create a highly available RDS Proxy named ha-proxy-broken for Aurora PostgreSQL cluster my-aurora-cluster in us-east-1, account 123456789012. The proxy must be multi-AZ. However, all provided subnets (subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb) are in the same AZ us-east-1a. Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds/db-credentials-abc. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rds-proxy-role.
eval_cases.expected_output:
RDS_PROXY: ha-proxy-broken
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] DB subnet group: subnets all in us-east-1a — multi-AZ proxy requires subnets in at least 2 AZs
